full_prompt_en: A square, densely detailed fantasy illustration is dominated by the head of a giant blue creature leaning in from the right. Its one enormous round yellow eye, with a dark center and ringed iris, sits above a long pointed snout that extends toward the left. Two tall, curved, ridged horns rise from its head toward the top edge, while a smaller blue projection juts out near the nose. Its wide mouth bends into a mischievous grin, exposing a row of small yellow teeth. Behind the head, the creature's body or surrounding dark surface is covered with nested circles in brown, tan, and ocher. The lower third opens into a miniature landscape filled with tiny whimsical forms: mushroom-like roofs, a pale blue rounded tower, winding paths, irregular plants, and small animal-like shapes. At the far left, a tall dark mushroom cap stands against the sky. The background is a strong yellow field with curling pale swirls; purple-pink cloud forms spiral across the upper-right corner. The giant head occupies most of the image, dwarfing the little settlement below. Every surface is patterned with fine stipple, tightly drawn contours, ridges, and repeated circular motifs. Color moves from mustard yellow and coral pink to teal blue, chocolate brown, and violet. Light appears broad and even, with gentle highlights on the snout and horns but no single realistic source. The composition contrasts playful scale, comic grotesquerie, and densely interlocking detail within a bright ornamental frame.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、细节密集的奇幻插画由右侧探入的巨大蓝色生物头部主导。一只庞大的圆形黄眼睛有深色中心和环状虹膜，位于向左伸出的长尖鼻口上方。两只高而弯曲、带棱脊的角从头顶升向画面上缘，鼻附近还有一根较小的蓝色突起。宽嘴弯成调皮笑容，露出一排小黄牙。头部后方，身体或周围深色表面覆盖棕、褐黄与赭色套叠圆环。下方三分之一打开成微缩景观，满是奇想小形状：蘑菇状屋顶、浅蓝圆塔、弯曲小路、不规则植物和小型动物般轮廓。最左侧，一个高高的深色蘑菇伞盖立在天空前。背景是强烈的黄色色场，上有卷曲浅色漩纹；紫粉色云形在右上角盘旋。巨头占据画面大部，令下方聚落显得极小。每个表面都有细点纹、紧密勾线、棱脊和重复圆形图案。颜色从芥黄和珊瑚粉转到青蓝、巧克力棕与紫色。光宽泛均匀，鼻口和角上有柔和亮部，却没有单一写实光源。构图在鲜亮装饰性画框中对照玩味尺度、漫画式怪诞和密实相嵌的细节。
style_prompt_en: Illustration combines crisp ink-like contours, dense stippling, and intricate repeated ornament with richly saturated flat-to-softly-shaded color. Exaggerate scale contrast between a dominant curved form and many tiny nested details, so the eye moves from one bold focal feature into an elaborate lower field. Use mustard yellow, teal blue, coral, violet, ocher, and deep brown in high-contrast yet coordinated patches. Spiral motifs, concentric circles, ridges, and curling outlines can echo across different surfaces without becoming a uniform wallpaper. Broad even light keeps the many elements readable; selective highlights give rounded parts dimension. The transferable effect is playful and uncanny, organized by strong silhouette, rhythmic surface pattern, and a vivid warm-cool palette.
style_prompt_zh: 插画把利落的墨线式轮廓、密集点描和复杂重复纹饰，与饱和丰富、从平涂到轻柔塑形的颜色结合。夸大主导曲面与大量微小嵌入细节之间的尺度反差，让视线从醒目焦点进入精密的下部色场。使用芥黄、青蓝、珊瑚、紫、赭和深棕，在高反差而协调的色块中排列。螺旋纹、同心圆、棱脊与盘曲轮廓可跨不同表面呼应，但不变成均匀墙纸。宽泛均匀的光让众多元素可读；选择性亮部赋予圆润部分体积。可迁移的效果既俏皮又奇异，由有力剪影、有节奏的表面纹样和鲜明冷暖色盘组织起来。
theme_en: A giant blue one-eyed creature above a fantastical village
theme_zh: 奇幻村庄上方一只巨大的蓝色独眼生物
name: Jim Woodring
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
